dedupe_keys.name: cuahsi hydrologic information system his and hydroclient discovery and download of hydrologic time series

description: The Hydrologic Information System (HIS) of CUAHSI, the Consortium of Universities for the Advancement of Hydrologic Science, is a system for discovering, accessing and publishing time series and sensor data. Its discovery portal, HydroClient (data.cuahsi.org), gives access to 100 data sources with over 5 million unique time series from federal agencies, university researchers and volunteer science groups through a single map interface, and returns all data in the same format to cut the time spent reformatting. Coverage: stream gauge measurements, meteorological station measurements, repeated grab samples and soil moisture, among others; the geographic spread follows the sources and was not read, though the named contributors are mainly US agencies and groups. Format and access: search, preview and download in the HydroClient web map; data providers publish through HydroServer; a HydroClient user guide is linked. Free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): BSD (HydroClient source code and documentation). Caveats: CUAHSI states that HIS is being modernised but remains available, so interfaces may change; the list of the 100 sources and the download formats were not read. Simulation uses: harmonised streamflow, weather and water quality series for calibrating hydrological, flood and water supply models and for hazard exposure studies of water infrastructure. Related records: HydroShare, the CUAHSI repository, holds several catalogued datasets such as the data-driven reservoir operation rules for 450+ US reservoirs (data-data-driven-reservoir-operation-rules-for-450-reservoirs-in-contiguous-united-states).
